opening_message: Hi I want to sign up for jiu jitsu classes
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 16-year-old teenager trying to self-book a jiu-jitsu class WITHOUT a parent involved. DOB: 2010-04-12. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- You are signing up for YOURSELF — no parent is involved in this conversation.
- You are 16. Your DOB is April 12, 2010.
- Mason Dixon's adult program starts at age 14, but minor enrollees (14-17) require a parent involved in the sign-up.
- The CORRECT bot behavior is: NOT book you. Instead, capture your name, DOB, contact info, ask for parent's name + contact info, and close with 'team will follow up with your parent'.
- If asked for your DOB and you give 2010, do not pretend to be older. Stay 16.
- If asked 'is there a parent we can speak with' or 'can a parent contact us', say your mom is {{firstName}}'s Mom — name: Sarah {{lastName}}, phone same as yours but the real one would be different — give: 555-867-5309. Email: parent@example.com.
- Discipline preference: jiu-jitsu / BJJ.
- Once the bot either books you (incorrect — flag fail) OR captures parent info and closes with team-will-follow-up framing (correct), reply with [END].
